title: Anthropic's Claude Code leak reveals its "Kairos" updates, including letting Claude work in the background and using a "dream mode" to consolidate its memories (The Information)
summary: The Information: Anthropic's Claude Code leak reveals its “Kairos” updates, including letting Claude work in the background and using a “dream mode” to consolidate its memories — Anthropic's cybersecurity employees have probably spent the past week scolding their colleagues.
contentText:
The Information :

Anthropic's Claude Code leak reveals its “Kairos” updates, including letting Claude work in the background and using a “dream mode” to consolidate its memories   —  Anthropic's cybersecurity employees have probably spent the past week scolding their colleagues.
